from build123d import *

knob_radius = 20.0
knob_height = 30.0
shaft_radius = 8.0
shaft_height = 10.0
rib_count = 6
rib_width = 2.0
rib_thickness = 1.0

set_screw_depth = 2.5

result = Pos(0, 0, knob_height/2) * Cylinder(knob_radius, knob_height)

result = result - set_screw

top_edges = result.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1:]
result = chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_size)

part = result
part.name = "knob_with_shaft_and_ribs"

hole_radius = set_screw_hole_diameter / 2.0
